//: One project serves two sites. letsappeal.com gets home.html (marketing homepage), start.letsappeal.com gets index.html (the ad landing page). This MUST use legacy `routes` rather than `rewrites`: Vercel evaluates `rewrites` AFTER the filesystem, so `/` matches index.html and a rewrite never fires. `routes` are evaluated BEFORE the filesystem, with `{ handle: filesystem }` as the fallthrough. Do not 'modernise' this back to `rewrites` without testing both hostnames.
